name: Fin by Intercom
tagline: Autonomous AI support agent that resolves customer tickets with zero hallucination guardrails.
definition: Fin is an autonomous customer support AI agent developed by Intercom. Powered by advanced reasoning models, it connects directly to company help centers and internal documentation to answer customer queries with zero-hallucination accuracy.
why_it_matters: Fin proved that AI support bots can achieve 50%+ resolution rates on complex customer tickets while maintaining human-level safety, shifting customer support from reactive agent desks to autonomous resolution.
workplace_use_cases: Resolving tier-1 support tickets (refund requests, password resets, order tracking)
Answering technical product support questions by searching help center articles
Seamlessly handing off complex edge cases to human support agents with full conversation context
Drafting real-time multilingual support responses for global customer support desks
how_to_use: Enable Fin in your Intercom inbox, point it at your public help desk URL or internal Notion/Confluence docs, configure fallback rules, and launch.
key_features: Guaranteed zero-hallucination guardrails grounded strictly in support docs
Resolves queries in 45+ languages automatically
Seamless human agent inbox handoff with summary notes
Pay-per-resolution pricing model

paid_plans.name: Fin Resolution Model
paid_plans.notes: Charged only when Fin successfully resolves a support conversation without human agent intervention.

name: Zendesk AI
tagline: Enterprise CX intelligence suite for intent detection, smart triage, and agent copilot assistance.
definition: Zendesk AI is an AI intelligence layer integrated across the Zendesk Customer Experience platform. It automatically categorizes incoming customer tickets by intent, sentiment, and language while providing support agents with inline summary tools and macro suggestions.
why_it_matters: Zendesk AI brings automated ticket routing and agent productivity tools directly into the dominant enterprise customer service desk platform, reducing handle times across thousands of corporate agents.
workplace_use_cases: Automatically detecting customer sentiment and prioritizing urgent escalation tickets
Summarizing long, multi-turn ticket threads for incoming support agents
Suggesting contextual knowledge base articles and macro responses to human agents
Automating intent classification (e.g. 'Billing', 'Bug Report', 'Feature Request')
how_to_use: Activate Zendesk AI in your Zendesk Admin Center, train intent models on past ticket data, and enable Agent Copilot in the agent workspace.
key_features: Automatic customer intent and sentiment detection on incoming tickets
Agent Copilot for inline response drafting and ticket summaries
Generative expand/rephrase tools for support agent replies
Pre-trained CX models tuned on billions of customer interactions

paid_plans.name: Zendesk AI Add-On
paid_plans.notes: Unlocks advanced AI intent detection, agent copilot, and generative features on top of Zendesk Suite plans.

name: Ada
tagline: Enterprise AI customer service agent platform resolving complex multi-channel support tickets.
definition: Ada is an enterprise AI customer service platform that resolves customer support inquiries across messaging, email, voice, and web chat.
why_it_matters: Ada provides enterprise organizations with no-code AI agent building that integrates directly into backend systems (Zendesk, Salesforce, Shopify).
workplace_use_cases: Resolving automated order tracking, refund requests, and billing queries
Deploying multi-channel AI support agents across web, mobile app, and WhatsApp
Executing automated backend account actions via API webhooks
how_to_use: Build agent workflows in Ada's visual dashboard, sync help documentation, and deploy the messaging widget.
key_features: Multi-channel resolution engine (Web, Mobile, SMS, Voice, WhatsApp)
No-code AI agent reasoning flow builder
Native integrations with Zendesk, Salesforce, and Shopify

pricing.free_tier_details: Custom enterprise quotes based on resolution volume.

paid_plans.name: Enterprise Resolution Plan
paid_plans.notes: Calculated per ticket resolution and channel support scope.

name: Lyro by Tidio
tagline: Conversational AI support bot for SMBs and e-commerce stores that answers customer questions.
definition: Lyro is a conversational AI customer support bot developed by Tidio, designed for small businesses and e-commerce stores to automate customer inquiries.
why_it_matters: Lyro offers small e-commerce businesses accessible AI support bot setup that syncs with Shopify in under 5 minutes.
workplace_use_cases: Answering e-commerce product questions and shipping policy inquiries 24/7
Reducing ticket volume for small support teams
Handing off complex sales leads to live human chat agents
how_to_use: Connect Tidio to your Shopify store or website, upload FAQ URLs, and activate Lyro.
key_features: 5-minute setup trained directly on website FAQ pages
Shopify and WordPress live chat integration
Seamless human agent handoff

paid_plans.name: Tidio Plus
paid_plans.notes: Custom AI conversations, dedicated support manager.

name: Chatling
tagline: No-code AI chatbot builder trained on custom website content, PDFs, and knowledge bases.
definition: Chatling is a no-code AI chatbot platform that allows businesses to build custom customer support chatbots trained on their website content and documents.
why_it_matters: Chatling simplifies custom support bot creation for non-technical teams with easy document uploading and web crawling.
workplace_use_cases: Building custom website support chatbots trained on PDF documentation
Answering visitor sales questions on SaaS marketing websites
Capturing sales lead contact details directly inside chat windows
how_to_use: Sign in at chatling.ai, input your website URL or upload PDF manuals, customize the chat widget, and embed.
key_features: Train AI on website URLs, PDFs, DOCX, and Notion pages
Custom branding and chat widget styling
Lead capture forms and visitor analytics

pricing.free_tier_details: Free plan includes 1 chatbot and 350 response credits/month.

paid_plans.name: Pro
paid_plans.notes: 5 chatbots, 5,000 response credits/month, auto-sync data sources.

name: Forethought
tagline: Generative AI customer service platform automating triage, resolution, and agent coaching.
definition: Forethought is an enterprise generative AI platform for customer service, featuring Solve (autonomous resolution), Triage (ticket routing), and Assist (agent copilot).
why_it_matters: Forethought brought deep learning intent resolution to enterprise support, reducing cost per ticket dramatically.
workplace_use_cases: Automating immediate support ticket resolution across email and chat
Routing incoming support tickets based on urgency and customer sentiment
Assisting human support agents with inline answer suggestions
how_to_use: Integrate Forethought with your enterprise helpdesk (Zendesk, Salesforce Service Cloud), and configure resolution rules.
key_features: Solve autonomous AI ticket resolution engine
Triage automated ticket routing and sentiment analysis
Assist in-inbox agent copilot

pricing.free_tier_details: Enterprise annual quotes based on ticket volume.

paid_plans.name: Enterprise Subscription
paid_plans.notes: Priced per ticket resolution and helpdesk integration scope.

name: Kustomer IQ
tagline: AI customer service automation platform optimizing omnichannel customer service conversations.
definition: Kustomer IQ is the artificial intelligence engine embedded in the Kustomer CRM, automating routing, sentiment analysis, and self-service chat workflows.
why_it_matters: Kustomer IQ unifies customer CRM data history with conversational AI chat across messaging apps.
workplace_use_cases: Providing customer support agents with a 360-degree timeline of customer interactions
Automating self-service chat workflows on WhatsApp and Instagram
Predicting customer sentiment during support interactions
how_to_use: Enable Kustomer IQ inside Kustomer CRM dashboard and set up self-service workflows.
key_features: Omnichannel timeline CRM integration
Self-service conversational bot builder
Automated ticket sentiment scoring

pricing.free_tier_details: Requires active Kustomer CRM platform subscription.

paid_plans.name: Enterprise
paid_plans.notes: Includes core Kustomer IQ routing and self-service bots.

name: Chatbase
tagline: Custom AI chatbot builder that creates ChatGPT-like bots trained on your data.
definition: Chatbase is a popular no-code AI chatbot creation platform that lets users build a custom support bot trained on files, web links, and Notion pages in minutes.
why_it_matters: Chatbase popularized quick, custom knowledge-base chatbot creation for creators and startups.
workplace_use_cases: Embedding a custom AI support chatbot on marketing websites
Creating internal documentation Q&A bots for employees
Answering customer product queries on e-commerce sites
how_to_use: Upload documents or enter website links at chatbase.co, customize chatbot appearance, and paste embed script.
key_features: Trained on PDFs, text files, website URLs, and Notion
Custom domain and chat widget branding options
Lead generation collection forms

pricing.free_tier_details: Free plan includes 1 chatbot and 20 message credits/month.

name: CustomGPT.ai
tagline: Privacy-first enterprise custom AI chatbot builder with zero hallucination protection.
definition: CustomGPT.ai is an enterprise custom AI platform that builds chatbots trained on company data with strict anti-hallucination guardrails and citations.
why_it_matters: CustomGPT.ai focuses heavily on enterprise data privacy and accurate citation backings for every answer.
workplace_use_cases: Building internal employee knowledge base Q&A bots with exact document citation links
Deploying customer support chatbots with zero hallucination protection
Searching across enterprise technical manuals
how_to_use: Upload data sources at customgpt.ai, configure persona guardrails, and deploy via widget or API.
key_features: Zero hallucination guardrails with document citation links
Supports 1,400+ file formats and site crawling
SOC 2 Type II certified data security
